description.value: Pho 68 is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant in Surrey, BC, with over two decades of community presence. It specializes in traditional noodle soups — including the signature Pho Dac Biet and spicy Bun Bo Hue — alongside desserts like the Everything Coconut. Cyclists can dine in or order online for pickup.
